'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**IDF fires warning shots and uses riot dispersal implements on 18 people entailing journalists and [[List of members of the 2022–2026 Lebanese Parliament|parliamentarian member]] Qassem Hashem, a member of the [[Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Lebanon Region|Lebanese Arab Socialist Ba’ath Party]] that crossed the Lebanese border walking 80 meters into Israeli-occupied [[Shebaa Farms|Shebaa Farms/Mount Dov region]] and walking up to Israel’s border barrier, according to Ali Shoeib, a [[Hezbollah]]-affiliated correspondent. [https://web.archive.org/web/20231227095132/https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-fires-warning-shots-as-lebanese-lawmaker-leads-group-across-israeli-border/ (Times Of Israel)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 South Korea floods]]
**Thirty-seven people are killed, several others are missing, and many are injured in [[South Korea]] when [[torrential rain]]s cause [[landslide]]s and the overflow of a [[dam]] in [[North Chungcheong Province|North Chungcheong]], prompting the evacuation of over 4,700 people nationwide. [[Prime Minister of South Korea|Prime Minister]] [[Han Duck-soo]] calls for the deployment of the [[Republic of Korea Armed Forces|military]] to conduct [[search and rescue]] operations. [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-landslides-floods-e9b1cbb109cae54e8094369e8ab340b9 (AP)]
*A [[wildfire]] prompts the evacuation of over 2,000 residents on [[La Palma]], [[Canary Islands]], [[Spain]], decimating around 4,500 hectares and destroying about a dozen homes. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-wildfires-canary-islands-climate-b80ab3039b9086541b1a63642b4a9809 (AP)]
*A fire breaks out and destroys the [[Royal Albion Hotel]], a 196-year-old [[Listed building#Categories of listed building|Grade II* listed building]], in [[Brighton and Hove]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/firefighters-tackle-blaze-at-prominent-200-year-old-hotel-on-brighton-seafront-12921672 (Sky News)] [https://inews.co.uk/news/historic-brighton-hotel-demolished-fire-2482077 (iNews)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 European heat waves]]
**The [[Ministry of Health (Italy)|Italian health ministry]] issues an "extreme" health risk warning for 16 [[List of cities in Italy|cities]], including [[Florence]] and [[Rome]], as the [[European Space Agency]] reports that potential record-breaking temperatures of up to {{convert|48|C}} could be reached. [https://edition.cnn.com/travel/article/italy-health-warning-europe-heatwave-saturday-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]] 
**[[Russia]] announces that it will investigate whether the [[North Korea]]n [[Hwasong-18]] missile landed in the [[Exclusive economic zone of Russia|country's exclusive economic zone]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/north-korea-test-missile-russia-waters-investigation-hwasong-18-rcna94417 (Reuters via NBC News)]
*[[South Korea–Ukraine relations]] 
**[[South Korean President]] [[Yoon Suk-yeol]] makes an unannounced visit to [[Kyiv]] and meets with [[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]], announcing that South Korea will pledge US$150 million in additional aid to Ukraine. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/15/south-korean-president-makes-surprise-visit-to-ukraine-in-show-of-support (AP via ''The Guardian'')]

***In [[tennis]], [[Markéta Vondroušová]] of the [[Czech Republic]] defeats [[Ons Jabeur]] of [[Tunisia]] in the final, 6–4, 6–4 to win the [[2023 Wimbledon Championships – Women's singles|women's singles]] title at the 2023 [[Wimbledon Championships]], becoming the first [[Seed (sports)|unseeded]] player in history to win the Wimbledon title.
